entities.name: Tertiary acetamide substrate
observations: Decoded SELFIES as CCN(CC(C)Nc1c(C)cccc1C)C(C)=O; contains an N,N-disubstituted acetamide.

entities.name: Lithium aluminum hydride
observations: Reagent components Li+, Al3+, and four H− correspond to LiAlH4; diethyl ether is also present.

entities.name: Reduced tertiary amine product
observations: Predicted product from LiAlH4 reduction of substrate amide: CCN(CC(C)Nc1c(C)cccc1C)CC; carbonyl carbon is converted to methylene.
